title: Mavci hook registration receipt
description: Proof that Claude Code actually LOADED this plugin's hooks. Written by doctor.mjs --preflight, which is wired as a SessionStart hook, so its existence is the evidence: nothing but a hook Claude Code chose to run can produce it. v0.1.2 installed cleanly, registered ZERO hooks after a hooks.json schema error, and doctor still reported 'hook self-test passed' because it was spawning the guard scripts itself rather than asking whether anything calls them. Excluded from CONTROL_GLOBS - it is rewritten every session, and a sealed receipt would break the control hash on every SessionStart - but still inside control/, so an agent cannot forge one.

event.description: Closed enum, mirrors HOOK_RUN_EVENTS in config.mjs. Only hook events that are actually wired to stamp a receipt belong here; adding one is a deliberate schema change, not a free-text field.

session_id.description: From the hook's stdin payload (NATIVE-CAPABILITIES 4.8). Null when Claude Code did not supply one.

env_session_id.description: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as seen by the hook process. Which of the three identity fields Claude Code populates is version-dependent, so a match on ANY is proof of this session and a match on none is not, by itself, proof of failure.
